dedupe_keys.name: bangladesh nepal and pakistan 5 km temperature and precipitation grids

description: The Figshare record holds 5 km grids of precipitation and minimum and maximum temperature for Bangladesh, Nepal and Pakistan over 1981–2016. The producers merged station observations with ERA5 reanalysis. The repository lists nine NetCDF files, one per variable and country, under CC BY 4.0 and without an access fee. Its landing description calls the contents monthly, and file names contain “monmean”; the describing article calls the product daily. This conflict has not been resolved by opening the data files, so modellers should check time coordinates before using it for daily flood or heat extremes. The grids can provide regional weather context for water supply, irrigation and climate impact simulations. They cover historical conditions, not future climate projections. They do not give asset locations or losses. Spatial detail is 5 km, but quality depends on station density and the ERA5 merging method. This resource complements data-era5-reanalysis with a station-adjusted regional product.
